question: Who organized the Independent Labour Party and Scheduled Castes Federation?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dr. Bhimrao Ramji Ambedkar**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Dr. Bhimrao Ramji Ambedkar** organized the Independent Labour Party and Scheduled Castes Federation.
 
• Dr. Ambedkar was a prominent social reformer and the principal architect of the Constitution of India.
 
• The Independent Labour Party was founded in 1936 to represent the interests of the labor class and marginalized communities.
